description: With an unknown predicate a result that is a splat over a failed source gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec passes an error in a result through only if that result is selected, and an unknown predicate selects neither, which is what hashicorp/hcl does. The spec doesn't say what type a result that failed contributes to the unified type: SplatExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) returns the dynamic value when its source has errors, so the conditional skips unification and gives the dynamic value.
